mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a continuous signal: lower values are associated with higher equity valuations due to reduced discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom regime (defined by HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 340000), consumer spending and economic activity are strong, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (2017=100) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 12800.0 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) signals an economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 215.0 signals aggressive monetary tightening and inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of retail sales (RSAFS) is a continuous signal: higher values are associated with stronger consumer spending and positive equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods (RSAFS > 340000) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
